title: Eurostat — flight-stage, O&D and dissemination coverage
note: PAS_BRD, ST_PAS and CAF_PAS describe flight-stage traffic; PAS_CRD is on-flight O&D. Total measures contain arrivals and departures. PAS_BRD includes direct-transit and non-revenue passengers. Routes are subject to publication thresholds; a missing row is not a zero. Paraphrase except the three-word heading.
